summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the default standard in 2026 for connecting AI agents and coding assistants to external tools, data sources, and services through a unified interface. The ecosystem spans aggregator platforms that host thousands of servers, gateways that add auth and governance, and individual MCP servers for specific services like GitHub, Playwright, and Figma. This matters because MCP lets agents move beyond text generation to actually take actions—reading repos, controlling browsers, querying databases—with standardized discovery, auth, and credentials.
ecosystem_note: Individual MCP servers expose a single tool or service (e.g. GitHub, Playwright), aggregators are marketplaces/registries that host and connect agents to many servers at once (e.g. Smithery, Composio), and gateways/proxies sit in front of servers to centralize authentication, routing, and governance (e.g. Cloudflare MCP, agentgateway).

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, and code search—lets agents read, create, and manage repos and workflows
tools.pricing_paid: Free; usage governed by existing GitHub plan limits (Free/Team/Enterprise)
strengths: Official first-party server maintained by GitHub
Deep repo, PR, and issue automation
Works across Cursor, Claude, VS Code, and most clients
tools.best_for: Automating repository workflows, code review, and issue management from an AI agent

tools.name: Playwright MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Browser automation—navigation, clicking, form filling, scraping, and end-to-end testing via accessibility tree
strengths: Deterministic browser control without screenshots/vision
Fast, reliable E2E testing and web scraping
Backed by Microsoft's Playwright team
tools.best_for: Giving agents reliable browser automation and web testing capabilities

tools.name: Filesystem MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Local file system—reading, writing, editing, and searching files and directories within allowed paths
strengths: Reference implementation from Anthropic
Essential local file access for coding agents
Simple, secure sandboxed path access
tools.best_for: Local file access for Cursor and desktop AI coding assistants

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Thousands of MCP servers and tools with hosted auth, credentials, and session management handled automatically
tools.pricing_paid: Paid tiers for teams and higher usage/hosted deployments
strengths: Largest hosted MCP registry/marketplace
Handles auth, credentials, and sessions for you
One-click deploy and connect for agents
tools.best_for: Discovering and connecting agents to many MCP tools without managing infrastructure

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ apps and tools (Gmail, Slack, Jira, Notion, GitHub, etc.) with managed auth for AI agents and MCP clients
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based and team plans beyond the free tier
strengths: Huge catalog of managed integrations
Built-in OAuth and auth handling
Strong developer SDKs and Cursor support
tools.best_for: Wiring agents into hundreds of SaaS apps with managed authentication

tools.name: Figma MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Figma design files—extracting layouts, components, styles, and design tokens to generate code from designs
tools.pricing_paid: Free; requires a Figma account (paid Figma plans for advanced features)
strengths: Official design-to-code bridge
Converts Figma frames into accurate code
Popular in frontend/design engineering workflows
tools.best_for: Generating front-end code directly from Figma designs

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Supabase Postgres databases, auth, storage, and edge functions—querying and managing projects via natural language
tools.pricing_paid: Free; usage governed by Supabase plan (Pro from ~$25/mo)
strengths: Official server for a widely used backend platform
Database querying and project management
Popular with full-stack AI development
tools.best_for: Letting agents manage and query Supabase backends

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP Servers
tools.connects_to: Cloudflare Workers, R2, D1, KV, and remote MCP hosting with OAuth—also enables deploying and gating remote MCP servers
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; Workers Paid from $5/mo plus usage-based pricing
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting with OAuth
Edge-deployed, globally scalable
Strong security and auth gateway features
tools.best_for: Deploying and securing remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Docker MCP Toolkit
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers—secure, sandboxed execution and a catalog of one-click MCP servers via Docker Desktop
strengths: Secure sandboxed server isolation
Curated MCP catalog in Docker Desktop
Unified gateway for running many servers safely
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers in secure, isolated containers

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion workspaces—reading and writing pages, databases, and docs for knowledge retrieval and content creation
tools.pricing_paid: Free; requires Notion account (paid Notion plans from ~$10/user/mo)
strengths: Official server for popular knowledge base
Reads and writes pages and databases
Great for docs and project knowledge access
tools.best_for: Connecting agents to team knowledge and documentation in Notion

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Sentry error tracking and performance monitoring—querying issues, stack traces, and debugging context for agents
strengths: Official observability integration
Pulls error context directly into agent workflows
Strong adoption among frontend/backend devs
tools.best_for: Giving agents access to error tracking and debugging data

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Stripe payments API—creating customers, invoices, payment links, and querying financial data via agents
tools.pricing_paid: Free; Stripe standard transaction fees apply
strengths: Official server for the leading payments platform
Agent-driven billing and payment operations
Well-documented toolset
tools.best_for: Automating payments and billing operations from an agent

tools.name: Slack MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Slack workspaces—reading channels and messages, posting, and searching conversation history
strengths: Most widely adopted Slack MCP (~1,800 GitHub stars, actively maintained in 2026)
Works without requiring admin app approval in many setups
Rich channel and message access
tools.best_for: Connecting agents to team communication and Slack history
